_doc: MANDATORY SAFETY GATE. Before ANY mutation other than the initial CREATE (edit/move/archive/restore/delete/reassign/hard-delete), the target's canonical id MUST appear here with lifecycle REGISTERED or ACTIVE, AND the acting worker must be authorized by access_scope. A synthetic-LOOKING display name is NEVER sufficient authorization on its own - real production entities could share a name prefix, and the whole point of the real-name digital-twin convention is that names are deliberately near-identical to real ones. Written only by the Fable QA Director (single-writer rule); workers request registration, they do not self-register.
_lifecycle_note: PLANNED is written BEFORE creation (no canonical id exists yet - Brain OS generates it at creation time; this is the documented bootstrap exception). CREATE is therefore the ONLY operation permitted against a fixture that is not yet REGISTERED. Immediately after creation the real generated canonical id is captured and the row moves CREATED -> REGISTERED -> ACTIVE. RETAINED means deliberately kept for regression re-runs rather than cleaned up.
_access_scope_note: PRIVATE_WORKER = only owner_worker_id may mutate. SHARED_SCENARIO = any worker in authorized_worker_ids running scenario_id may mutate. SHARED_CAMPAIGN = any authorized worker in the campaign. Highly destructive ops on shared fixtures (hard-delete a shared parent company, delete a shared project, archive a shared top-level org, delete a manager several scenarios depend on) require Fable QA Director coordination so one worker does not invalidate another's in-flight scenario - unless that collision IS the chaos test being run.
